text:
The jorobado in the parque

solitario señor

apuntalado between the árboles and the water

desde that the candado of the garden is abre

for that entren the árboles and the water

until the lóbrega campana dominguera in the crepúsculo,


come the pan that ha traído in a diario

bebe the water of the jarro encadenado

that the children llenaron of pedruscos

in the estanque where hice navegar my barco,

for the night durmió in a perrera

but without that nadie le pusiera cadenas.


As the pájaros of the parque ha venido temprano

is sentó as the water

and señor it llamaban eh señor

the chiquillos bribones of the lugar

that escapaban apenas the oía

until alejarse of his vista


more allá of the lago and the rosales

riéndose when the another agitaba his diario

encorvado in the burla

pasaban for the zoológico sonoro of the arboleda of the sauces

esquivando to the cuidador of the parque

with his palo of juntar the hojas.


And the old perro aletargado

solitario between the niñeras and the cisnes

mientras desde the sauces the chiquillos

hacían that the tigres saltaran of his eyes

for rugir between the piedras rocosas

and the bosques is azulaban of marineros


trabajó the day entero until the hora of cerrar

in a figura of woman without fallas

erguida as a young olmo

alta and erguida surgió of his huesos torcidos

for that of night is pusiese of pie

tras the cerrojos and the cadenas


All the night in the parque deshecho

tras the arbustos and the rejas

the pájaros the pasto the árboles the lago

and the children inocentes as fresas

habían ido in pos of the jorobado

until his perrera in the sombras.

translation.title: The jorobado in the parque
